thread:
Priya Kapoor: FYI — CedarLoop reporting a sudden p99 tail at ~12:09 UTC, their dashboard shows a spike from ~250ms to ~3s. They say it started after a marketing batch job. Can we triage?
Alex Chen: saw the alert, checking tenant metrics. p50 fine, p95 ~400ms, p99 ~3s. Lots of concurrency from tenant=cedarloop.
Jordan Blake: tagging for noisy neighbor checks @Alex Chen. Any quota or burst exhaustion logs?
Alex Chen: There's a soft throttle firing on the API side (tenant token bucket depletion) followed by queue backlog on worker pool. Logs: `throttle: tenant=cedarloop reason=burst_limit token_delta=-120`
Marta Ruiz: CedarLoop says they run bulk-embeds job every few hours. Could be correlation. Do we have per-tenant queue depth history?
OpsBot: @channel incident detected: tenant_backpressure ced-224 deploy-pool-7 high-queue 12:08:43 -> 12:22:10
Priya Kapoor: I replied to CedarLoop asking for exact job window and retries. Also offered temporary reservation.
Jordan Blake: Short-term mitigation options: 1) add cedarloop to ephemeral reservation (fast), 2) raise their per-tenant burst allowance (risky), 3) apply a per-tenant weighting to reduce impact on others.
Alex Chen: I can push ephemeral reservation for 30m if CS approves. That would isolate them to reserved workers so others should see tails drop.
Marta Ruiz: If we do reservation, we should also enable circuit-breaker fallback to smaller model to avoid long per-token times on overload.
Priya Kapoor: CedarLoop accepted reservation offer. Please proceed with 30m and let me know TTL.
Alex Chen: Applying reservation now. Command: `./infra/cli reserve --tenant cedarloop --pool reserved-fast --duration 30m`
OpsBot: Reservation created: tenant=cedarloop pool=reserved-fast expires=2249878343
Alex Chen: After reservation, p99 dropped from 3s -> 350ms within 2 min. Good signal.
Priya Kapoor: Passing update to customer: "We applied a short reservation and saw p99 improve, we're investigating root cause and next steps."
Jordan Blake: Root cause hypothesis: their batch job does many parallel long-context generations causing KV cache churn + async retries that backpressure the shared worker queue. Need to confirm with traces.
Alex Chen: Pulled traces for 12:05-12:15 window. Pattern: many requests with seq_len ~2048, model=rw_large_v1, and client-side retry loop issuing 8 parallel requests. Sample trace excerpt: ```request_id=abc123 tenant=cedarloop model=rw_large_v1 seq=2048 latency=2.9s retries=3```
Marta Ruiz: Could be a combination of model choice + concurrency. Suggest recommendations: 1) advise customer to shard bulk job over time, 2) set client-side concurrency cap, 3) suggest smaller model or quantized variant for bulk run.
Priya Kapoor: I'll include that in notes and propose a scheduled reservation for their nightly job. Also offering guidance doc.
Jordan Blake: Ops followup actions: - Create a safe allowlist to exempt cedarloop from shared throttles while reservation active? We should avoid permanent exemptions. - Add adaptive per-tenant queue weights to reduce tail blast radius. - Add alerting for concurrent long-seq bursts.
Alex Chen: Created a short-lived allow rule instead of global exemption: `allowlist add --tenant cedarloop --scope=backpressure --ttl=2h --reason="bulk-run warmfix"`
OpsBot: Allowlist updated: cedarloop scope=backpressure ttl=2h id=aw-77821
Marta Ruiz: Filed an engineering ticket for adaptive weighting and better per-tenant burst detection: INF-1293. Assigning to eng-runtime team.
Priya Kapoor: Customer asked for timeline on permanent fix. I told them 2-3 weeks for platform change, recommended scheduling reserved capacity for nightly batch in meantime.
Jordan Blake: One more note — add heartbeat/gradual ramp suggestion to docs for large batch runs. If they ramp from 10 -> 200 concurrent requests over 15m we can avoid sudden KV cache churn.
Alex Chen: Re-checking metrics at 12:35 — system stable, p99 for other tenants unaffected post-reservation. I'll keep the reservation until CedarLoop confirms job completes.
Priya Kapoor: CedarLoop confirmed their job finished and latency back to normal after we left reservation. They accepted our docs and requested a scheduled reservation product option.
Marta Ruiz: Closing timeline: detection 12:08, reservation 12:13, p99 improved by 12:15, job finished 12:40. Putting notes into the ticket and adding recommended customer guidance.
Jordan Blake: Kudos team. We'll track INF-1293 and revisit rate-limit tuning. :thumbsup:
Priya Kapoor: thanks everyone. I'll update the support ticket and customer success playbook.
Alex Chen: leaving monitoring on for 2 hours then tear down allowlist.
OpsBot: Allowlist aw-77821 scheduled to expire at 2249880743.
